qualification: All current JSON field values preserved and exactly reconstructed. Reading a reference requires also actually reading its shared definition. This representation is not source reading or semantic approval.

shared_definitions.D1: All preceding metadata/reader/image/filesystem operations normal unless this fact names their failure; external .NET effects not executed.
shared_definitions.D4: Normal API/query calls and stable windows within loop; supplied returns only select visible branches; geometry/ownership/timing never observed.
shared_definitions.D5: Normal loading in declared sorted order, matching schema and no plugin replacement. Full downstream engine consumer closure remains pending.
shared_definitions.D6: Source pixel values/DOM requests only; no browser load or visual result.
shared_definitions.D11: PURPOSE_AND_EXPLICIT_DOMAIN_SCOPE; checked against assignment, not a runtime assertion
shared_definitions.D12: SOURCE_TRACEABILITY_IDENTITY; source bytes independently bound in identities
shared_definitions.D13: Each exact case retains its stated fixture; no default-map/Demo execution implied

value.scope: Only declared planning obligations; actual source interfaces remain open until source/receiver review
